question: Find the value of x satisfying: 5(5x² − 5) − 5(5x² + 7x − 2) = 14
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Observe that the **quadratic terms** (x²) have coefficients 25 and −25, which will cancel out.

Directly focus on the linear term and constants: −35x + (−25 + 10) = 14.

⇒ −35x − 15 = 14 ⇒ −35x = 29.

⇒ x = −29/35.

**∴ The correct answer is −29/35.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

5(5x² − 5) − 5(5x² + 7x − 2) = 14

**Formula/Method Used:**

**Distributive Property** of multiplication over addition: a(b + c) = ab + ac.

**Calculations:**

⇒ 25x² − 25 − (25x² + 35x − 10) = 14

⇒ 25x² − 25 − 25x² − 35x + 10 = 14

⇒ (25x² − 25x²) − 35x + (−25 + 10) = 14

⇒ −35x − 15 = 14

⇒ −35x = 14 + 15

⇒ −35x = 29

⇒ x = −29/35

**∴ The correct answer is −29/35.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Linear Equations

A **Linear Equation** is an algebraic equation in which each term has an exponent of 1 and the graph of the equation is a straight line.

Transposition Rule

While moving a term from one side of the equation to the other, the **sign changes** (plus becomes minus, and minus becomes plus).

Distributive Law

This law states that multiplying a sum by a number gives the same result as multiplying each addend individually by the number and then adding the products together.</p
